conv_datapath.sizing_workload: Kimi K3 KDA BF16 conv state

memory.persistent_state_policy: HBM streaming with ping-pong head tiles

required_features: transparent Matrix-result to X_STATE projection FIFO with Vector-SRAM spill fallback
fused state update and C reduction
streaming state DMA with two head-tile slots
queue-specific FENCE and completion event scoreboard
logical HBM, cache, bank stall, and cycle counters
not_claimed: full Nemotron or Kimi persistent state residency

selection_rationale.rtx5090_profile_scope: official standalone NemotronHMamba2Mixer with random BF16 weights
selection_rationale.rtx5090_stage_percentage_denominator: active CUDA GPU kernel time inside nemotron.profile; CPU launch gaps excluded
selection_rationale.kda_rtx5090_profile_scope: official KimiDeltaAttention mixer with real dimensions and random BF16 weights
selection_rationale.why_two_head_lanes: One lane with ping-pong already reaches the modeled BF16 Mamba streaming HBM floor. Two lanes are retained for KDA and resident-state throughput, not for Mamba streaming.
selection_rationale.why_not_four_head_lanes: No modeled streaming gain; doubles FMA lanes, banks, and head-tile SRAM.
selection_rationale.why_not_sixteen_banks: Matches streaming HBM limit but slows resident KDA from 73.7 to 98.3 us/layer.
